note: GROUNDWORK PLATFORM DEFAULT — Tyler's decisions, 2026-08-22, on which channels feed the receipt/document-upload pipeline (src/ui/document-upload.tsx, src/ai/receipts.ts). This is deliberately separate from ingest.sources.json, which is P&L/bank-export FORMAT detection for admin-uploaded files, not a live channel. quickbooks_sync/bank_feed_sync here mean a live API/OAuth connection pulling documents automatically — neither exists in this codebase; QuickBooks live integration is Item 3, a separate scoped project (Phase 1: read-only import). Enabling a channel here with enabled:false but no implementation is a config statement of intent, not a toggle for code that already exists — flipping it to true without building the connector would do nothing.
